title: Annota document.json, format 1.x
description: The scene graph inside a .annota file (a ZIP archive with document.json, original.png, thumbnail.png and images/<n>.png for embedded images). Coordinates are document pixels: one unit is one pixel of original.png, origin at its top-left corner, y down, angles in degrees clockwise. Readers of format 1.x accept every minor version: unknown keys at any depth, unknown object types, unknown background types and objects a reader cannot interpret are preserved and written back. A higher major version is refused.

format.description: Format version MAJOR.MINOR. Minor versions only add optional data.

requires.description: Oldest Annota release that reads this format ("0.1" for format 1.x). Shown when a reader is too old.

generator.description: Annota version that wrote the file, informational.

image.description: The original image, always at document position (0, 0).

canvas.description: The exported area. Starts as the image bounds; x/y become negative when the canvas is extended to the left or top.

title.description: Document name shown as the window title.

scale_factor.description: Device scale of the captured screen.

source.description: The file the document belongs to.

color.description: sRGB colour with straight alpha, #RRGGBBAA (#RRGGBB is accepted on read).

background.description: The types format 1.0 defines. Readers treat a background type they do not know (from a newer minor version) as transparent and write it back unchanged.

blur.description: Gaussian standard deviation in document pixels.

object.description: One scene node: id, type and the type's own fields. Unknown types are kept as they are.

image_object.description: A bitmap placed as an object (picture in picture).

source.description: ZIP entry of the embedded image.
